articles.title: Texas electric grid moratorium won’t have big impact on BTC miners: Bernstein
articles.summary: Monday’s announcement that Texas Governor Greg Abbott set a moratorium on approval of ERCOT-linked data centers pending an audit won’t impact miners’ approved electricity contracts.

articles.title: Tether Gold reserves rise 9.5% as gold posts worst quarter in 13 years
articles.summary: XAUt added to its bullion backing during gold’s worst quarter since 2013, as tokenized commodity holder counts continued to rise.

articles.title: Italy’s biggest bank triples staked Ether ETF holdings while cutting IBIT shares
articles.summary: Italy’s largest bank Intesa Sanpaolo increased its staked Ether ETF position to $7.1 million while reducing its holdings in two spot Bitcoin ETFs.

articles.title: Jim Cramer plans to sell his Bitcoin over quantum fears as BTC rises 1.6%
articles.summary: The CNBC personality said he’ll sell his Bitcoin holdings due to fears about quantum computing, as some cryptocurrency investors celebrated, referencing the popular “inverse Cramer” meme.

articles.title: Former FBI supervisor admits guilt in $1M crypto theft
articles.summary: A former FBI supervisory agent pleaded guilty to stealing about $1 million worth of digital assets from an adversarial country and forfeited about $925,000 in funds to government-controlled wallets.

articles.title: Strategy’s STRC retakes $90 after 24% rebound from June closing low
articles.summary: The preferred shares have recovered nearly 24% from their June closing low as Strategy builds its cash reserve and repurchases STRC.

articles.title: US yen intervention puts Bitcoin, risk assets on notice for liquidity flux
articles.summary: The first US-Japan joint yen intervention in 28 years came amid record bond yields and worries about the yen carry trade.

articles.title: Nauru, the world's 3rd-smallest country, changes its name to Naoero
articles.summary: The Pacific Island country of Nauru has changed its name to the Republic of Naoero, its president said, matching the spelling and pronunciation in the national language.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: AI wins come with an old investor risk
articles.summary: From a surprise yuan devaluation in 2015 to crackdowns in recent years, many of Beijing's policy moves appear abrupt to outsiders.

articles.title: With U.S. doors shutting, Cubans turn to Brazil for asylum
articles.summary: For years, many Cubans hoping to leave the island looked to the United States. Now, with legal pathways largely closed, a growing number are heading to Brazil instead.

articles.title: Todd Blanche rescinds 'anti-weaponization fund'. And, Trump calls off striking Iran
articles.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche rescinds President Trump's anti-weaponization fund ahead of his confirmation hearing. And, the president calls off strikes on Iran over a potential deal.

articles.title: Rare photos of ex-Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi give her family hope
articles.summary: Kim Aris, son of Aung San Suu Kyi, told NPR that photographs of his mother meeting a foreign official gave him "a reason to hope" for the first time since the military coup that ousted her in 2021.

articles.title: U.S. steps in to help shore up Japanese yen
articles.summary: The U.S. dollar weakened against the Japanese yen Monday after the leaders of both countries confirmed they intervened in the markets to help shore up Japan's currency.

articles.title: Morocco denies responsibility for events at its border with Spain, as deaths near 100
articles.summary: Four days after tens of thousands of migrants crossed from Morocco into the small Spanish territory of Ceuta, the death toll continues to rise -- nearing 100.

articles.title: Israel says it has serious concerns with the White House's Hamas disarmament deal
articles.summary: President Trump announced a proposed disarmament deal with Hamas last week. Israeli strikes overnight and into Sunday evening killed at least 17 people, including children, in Gaza.
